name: Hemolytic Disease Due to Fetomaternal Alloimmunization

ethnicAssociations: More common in populations with higher prevalence of Rh-negative blood group

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Laboratory Diagnostic Criteria for Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn

criteria.description: Presence of maternal alloantibodies against fetal red blood cell antigens
Laboratory evidence of fetal or neonatal hemolysis including anemia and elevated bilirubin
Positive direct antiglobulin (Coombs) test in the neonate
Ultrasound evidence of fetal hydrops or anemia
History of previous affected pregnancies or blood transfusions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of maternal alloantibodies with laboratory evidence of fetal/neonatal hemolysis and a positive direct antiglobulin test
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is supported by prenatal ultrasound and maternal history.

pathognomonic.notes: Jaundice appearing within 24 hours of birth
